text:
Maya K: hey team — finishing up onboarding and hit a wall with cloud access for the HIPAA project. I can’t list the project or view billing: `gcloud projects list` returns a 403. also need to assume an AWS role into the prod HIPAA account but getting AccessDenied. who should i ping for the HIPAA onboarding flow?
Priya R: @Maya K welcome! For HIPAA projects we do an extra step: billing access + compliance flag. i can start GCP role grants. can you paste your work email and the project id (not the display name)?
Maya K: email is maya.k@redwood.com and project id is redwood-hipaa-prod-1
Samir: for AWS, the common pattern is assume-role via SSO -> assume-role. try this snippet (after SSO login):
```
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::987654321098:role/Redwood_HIPAA_ReadOnly --role-session-name maya-onboard
```
Make sure you have MFA and that your Okta groups include `hipaa-devs`. If you still get AccessDenied post-SSO, it's usually missing the SCIM group mapping.
Maya K: tried the aws command after SSO — got `AccessDenied` with message "not authorized to perform sts:AssumeRole"
Infra Oncall: pinging infra team. @Priya R i can temporarily add maya to billing-viewers and hipaa-devs if compliance approves. will wait for ticket.
Priya R: i created the internal request: BIL-3421 (billing access) and COMPL-157 (HIPAA attestations). tagged @Jamie S for compliance review.
Jamie S: acknowledged. quick checklist: 1) completed HIPAA training (yes/no) 2) signed BAA (we have a copy for new hires) 3) manager approval. maya — did you complete the training link in 1Password?
Maya K: yep training completed yesterday and manager signed off in the onboarding doc.
Priya R: okay i'm granting `roles/viewer` on redwood-hipaa-prod-1 and adding you to the billing-viewers group, will log actions in the ticket. infra-oncall — please add `hipaa-devs` Okta group to maya's SSO mapping for the AWS account 987654321098.
Infra Oncall: done — added to group and pushed SCIM sync. you may need to re-login to SSO (okta).
CloudOpsBot: Automated: SCIM sync completed for group hipaa-devs at 2026-03-23T14:32:10Z.
Maya K: re-logged into SSO, retried `aws sts assume-role` and it worked — temporary creds returned. also re-ran `gcloud projects list` and now shows redwood-hipaa-prod-1. :tada:
Priya R: great! i've updated BIL-3421 / COMPL-157 with the grants and compliance notes. please keep any HIPAA data usage to the approved sandboxes until you get dev access.
Maya K: thanks everyone — huge help. let me know if there's anything else i should read for HIPAA infra patterns.
Samir: ping me if you need help with temporary session tokens or configuring `~/.aws/config` profiles.
Jamie S: welcome aboard! i'll DM the HIPAA checklist and preferred logging steps.
Maya K: appreciated :heart:
__notes: thread contains root message + replies; messages are chronological and short, with inline commands and bot notes
